column1: Maximum total invested capital = 80% of account.
Maximum initial position in one stock = €50.
Maximum total exposure to one stock = €100.
Maximum portfolio risk from open positions = 2%.
Never add money to a position that is currently losing.
All calculations use CLOSED candles only.
Do not trade during pre-market or after-hours.
Do not buy a stock if earnings are within 3 trading days.
Do not trade if bid/ask spread > 0.5%.
Do not open a new position if daily portfolio loss >= 1.5%.
If portfolio falls 5% from its highest-ever value:
reduce all new buy amounts by 60%.
If portfolio falls 8% from its highest-ever value:
Resume normal trading only after market conditions return to bullish
Never buy the same stock more than once per day.
